title: Week 1 of Card Cutout 3D modeling
author: StrongLegStrongMan
selftext:
I have been working on 3D modeling using Image gen and card cutouts. The results are surprisingly beautiful models. I have the cross cut and the glue cut. The glue cut is working great beyond my expectations. 

You can have the AI make multiple glue cuts and then glue them all together. The models are very tiny compared to everything else I have been working on. I dropped my models from 50 Mb to 1-4 Mb with this method. 

The weaker model in my video is the very first experiment I ever did. It still has the glue separation so I can demo it for you guys. The newer model is further cutout experimentation and I cannot do it anymore. I wish this type of Model would be promoted and big AI companies focused on it. I think it would benefit all of us.
